inputs.checklistItemText: Plans do not include required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines
inputs.question: Are there any notes on the cover sheet or general notes sheet indicating that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines? Look for any references to Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752 or 48-hour notification requirements.

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether a specific note or text exists on the plan sheets (presence and content check), not measuring distances, inspecting spatial relationships in drawings, or reasoning about geometric symbols—this is a document/note-presence verification task.
